```{julia}
using CairoMakie
using LinearAlgebra

using MMJMesh.Plots
using MMJMesh.Mathematics
```

## Funktionen approximieren

### Funktionen

```{julia}
x = parameter(0 .. 4π)
f = cos(x)
g = 1 - x / (4π)
h = f * g

fplot(f, g, h)
```

### Funktionswerte

::: {.solution}
```{julia}
x = [1, 3, 7]
y = h.(x)
p = fplot(h)
scatter!(x, y, color=:tomato)
p
```
:::

::: {.scaffold}
```{julia}
```
:::

### Approximation

Funktion

::: {.solution}
```{julia}
nodes = range(0, 4π, 6)
phis = hatfunctions(nodes)
uHat = h.(nodes)
ha = uHat ⋅ phis
fplot(ha, h)
```
:::

::: {.scaffold}
```{julia}
```
:::

Fehler

```{julia}
e = h - ha
fplot(e)
```

### Konvergenz

Funktion um Approximationsfehler zu berechnen

::: {.solution}
```{julia}
norm2(f) = sqrt(integrate(f * f, domain(f)))

function error(Ne)
    nodes = range(0, 4π, Ne + 1)
    phis = hatfunctions(nodes)
    ha = h.(nodes) ⋅ phis
    return norm2(h - ha)
end

error(4)
```
:::

::: {.scaffold}
```{julia}
```
:::

Approximationsfehler für $2, 4, 8, ..., 2^{10}$ Elemente

::: {.solution}
```{julia}
Nes = 2 .^ (2:10)
hs = 4π ./ Nes
es = error.(Nes)
```
:::

::: {.scaffold}
```{julia}
```
:::

::: {.solution}
```{julia}
scatterlines(Nes, es)
```

:::

## Zur Interpretation von loglog-Plots

```{julia}
mks = monomials(1:4, 0.0001 .. 1)
fplot(mks...)
```

```{julia}
f = Figure()
Axis(f[1, 1], xscale=log10, yscale=log10)
fplot!(mks...)
f
```
